_meta.what_this_is: A fan-out plan: eight work items (files f1..f8) assigned to three parallel workers. The assignment is broken on purpose in two ways: f3 is handed to two workers (an overlap -> one worker's write is clobbered), and f8 is handed to no worker (a gap -> never written). A correct plan is a true partition of the eight files.
_meta.plan_is: A FIXTURE. Authored with exactly one overlap and one gap so both failure modes are visible. Point the contract at your own fan-out assignment (files a subagent will write, tasks a worker owns).
